title: UX Designer Intern [Summer 2027] (Visual Experience Design, Future Platforms)
note: Robotaxi rider-experience internship open to interaction, industrial, visual and motion design majors graduating Fall 2027 to Summer 2028.

facts.duties: Design rider journeys across screens, cabin lighting and audio, including motion; make visuals for physical controls and lighting; build prototypes and present vision concepts to leadership.
facts.requirements: Bachelor's or Master's student graduating Fall 2027–Summer 2028; visual design portfolio with digital and physical work; motion skills; Figma prototyping; able to relocate to the Bay Area.
facts.apply: Apply on the Lever posting with portfolio.
